# svgworm

> CLI that turns a folder of SVG files into type-safe, content-hashed SVG sprites, a manifest and TypeScript types. A thin React adapter (@svgworm/react) renders icons in Server Components with zero client JavaScript. Status: pre-alpha, v0.1 in progress, not yet on npm.

Use it when a Next.js App Router (or any) app has its own folder of SVG icons and needs: no client JS, icon names checked at compile time, correct colors per icon (mono follows currentColor, multicolor is kept), gradients/masks/filters that render in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, and byte-identical output on every OS.

Requires Node ^22.20 || >=24.11. Package manager: pnpm.

## How to use it

Fastest path: `svgworm init --yes` (add `--agents-md` to get a svgworm section in AGENTS.md). It writes `svgworm.config.json`, `predev`/`prebuild` scripts and `components/icon.tsx`, prints the install commands, and never overwrites a file that differs. Manual steps:

1. Put SVG files in a folder, for example `icons/`.
2. Run `svgworm --source icons`. It writes `public/icons/icons.<hash>.svg` (and `icons.stack.<hash>.svg` when an icon needs it) and, in `svgworm/`, `icons.js`, `icons.d.ts` and `manifest.json`.
3. In a Server Component file: `export const Icon = createIcon(manifest)` with `import { createIcon } from '@svgworm/react'` and `import { manifest } from '../svgworm/icons.js'`.
4. Render `<Icon name="home" />`. The icon is aria-hidden unless `title` or `label` is passed. An invalid name is a type error.
5. Run `svgworm` in `predev` and `prebuild`. In CI, `svgworm check` exits 1 when the committed output is stale. `svgworm watch` rebuilds on every change.
6. Optional: serve `/icons/:file*` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. With a Next `basePath`, set `--public-path` to include it.

## Non-interactive use

- Commands: `build` (default), `check` (exit 1 if the committed output is stale, writes nothing), `watch` (rebuild on change), `init` (project setup). All take the config flags below; `init` also takes `--component-file <path>`, `--no-component`, `--no-scripts`, `--agents-md`, `--yes`, and prompts only on an interactive terminal.
- Flags: `--config <file>`, `--source <dir>` (repeatable), `--out-dir <dir>`, `--public-path <path>`, `--module-dir <dir>`, `--flatten`, `--json`. Flags override the config file. `--out-dir` needs `--public-path`.
- `--json` prints one JSON document on stdout and nothing else.
- Exit codes: 0 built or check up to date; 1 invalid SVG, name collision or I/O failure (nothing is written), or stale output from `check`; 2 usage or config error, or no SVG files found.
- Config file `svgworm.config.json` has a JSON Schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmlweb/svgworm/main/packages/svgworm/svgworm.schema.json (`svgworm/schema.json` once published).

## Not in v0.1

Several sprites, inline sprite, incremental watch (watch rebuilds everything), frameworks other than React.
